paired_scenario_manifest.generation_rule: Generate only after freeze from the named final family using held-out-mission-scenario-generator-v1; do not run or inspect a generated scenario before its scheduled run.
paired_scenario_manifest.virtual_allocation_rule: For each condition, schedule scenario indices 0 through 19. Assign index i to family_order[i mod 3], yielding 7, 7, and 6 runs respectively. The same index is paired across the FIFO and latest-pending variant of a load profile.
paired_scenario_manifest.indexed_variation_rule: For a family and scenario index i, seed randomization from the first 8 bytes of SHA-256(family_id + ':' + decimal(i)), big-endian. Offset target center y by uniform[-0.3, 0.3] m; for narrow scenes also offset both corridor blocks by uniform[-0.1, 0.1] m. Open and cluttered obstacle layouts remain fixed. This rule is part of held-out-mission-scenario-generator-v1.

native_paced.pairing_rule: For each final family and repetition index, run every backend against the same generated state and mission request in listed backend order. No result selects or removes a later scheduled run.

pacing_validity_rule.scope: Every native-paced planning tick in every scheduled native closed-loop run.
pacing_validity_rule.valid_when: Each recorded pacing_overrun_s is less than or equal to 0.02 seconds; a run with a larger overrun is invalid evidence, not a successful result.

post_freeze_execution_order: Verify all prerequisite gates, candidate hashes, scenario-family identities, and clean output destination before generating any final family.
Generate and run each scheduled virtual condition in manifest order; retain every trace and failure.
Run native-paced pairs in final-family, repetition, then backend order; retain every trace and failure.
Run the 1000-batch by three-repetition saved-input replay without using it as closed-loop timing evidence.
Write the browser JSON, report, run index, trace files, timing provenance, and bootstrap intervals only after all scheduled work has completed or an allowed stop is recorded.
stopping_rules: Run the exact reviewed sample counts; do not stop early for favorable or unfavorable results.
Stop only for invalid evidence, configuration drift, infrastructure failure, or a failed prerequisite gate.
Retain every completed result before a stop and report the stop reason.
Any tuning after held-out execution requires a new model version and a new untouched final set.
review_blockers: The separately accepted live-provider and portable-hosting records do not replace the required quality-threshold review.
